steps.name: environment - install/validate JDK, Maven, jq, persist env vars and JAVA_HOME
steps.description: Install or validate OpenJDK >=17, Maven CLI >=3.8.6, and jq. Create en_US.UTF-8 locale if missing and persist LANG/LC_ALL and Spring defaults (SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE, SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL, SERVER_PORT) plus JAVA_HOME into /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh so future shells inherit them. Use non-interactive apt, group installs, and validate versions using robust comparators. Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-management-system-40496-40506/spring_backend
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-management-system-40496-40506/spring_backend"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
# Ensure locale
if ! locale -a 2>/dev/null | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | grep -q '^en_us.utf-8$'; then
  sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q locales >/dev/null
  sudo locale-gen en_US.UTF-8 >/dev/null || true
  sudo update-locale LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 >/dev/null || true
fi
# Install required packages idempotently (maven, openjdk-17, jq)
PKGS=()
if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKGS+=(openjdk-17-jdk); fi
# Maven: check version if present
MAVEN_OK=0
if command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MVN_VER=$(mvn -v 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/Apache Maven \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 || true)
  if [ -n "$MVN_VER" ] && dpkg --compare-versions "$MVN_VER" ge "3.8.6" 2>/dev/null; then MAVEN_OK=1; fi
fi
if [ "$MAVEN_OK" -ne 1 ]; then PKGS+=(maven); fi
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKGS+=(jq); fi
if [ ${#PKGS[@]} -ne 0 ]; then sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends "${PKGS[@]}"; fi
# Validate java version >=17
if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "java not available" >&2; exit 11; fi
JAVA_MAJOR=$(java -version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/.*version "\([0-9]\+\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 || true)
if [ -z "$JAVA_MAJOR" ] || [ "$JAVA_MAJOR" -lt 17 ]; then echo "java major version <17 detected: $JAVA_MAJOR" >&2; exit 12; fi
# Determine JAVA_HOME from update-java-alternatives or /usr/lib/jvm
JAVA_HOME=""
if command -v update-java-alternatives >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  JAVA_HOME=$(readlink -f "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v java)")")/.." ) || true
fi
if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -d /usr/lib/jvm ]; then
  JAVA_HOME=$(ls -d /usr/lib/jvm/java-*-openjdk* 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
fi
: "${JAVA_HOME:=}"
# Persist environment to /etc/profile.d
sudo bash -c 'cat > /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh <<"PROFILE"
export LANG="en_US.UTF-8"
export LC_ALL="en_US.UTF-8"
export SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE="dev"
export SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL="jdbc:h2:mem:testdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1"
export SERVER_PORT="8080"
PROFILE'
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh
# Append JAVA_HOME if found
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then
  sudo bash -c "echo export JAVA_HOME=\"$JAVA_HOME\" >> /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh"
fi
# Source into current shell for immediate use
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh || true
# Final validations
command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "mvn not available" >&2; exit 13; }
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "jq not available" >&2; exit 14; }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-management-system-40496-40506/spring_backend"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
# Ensure en_US.UTF-8 locale exists
if ! locale -a 2>/dev/null | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | grep -q '^en_us.utf-8$'; then

  sudo apt-get install -y -q locales --no-install-recommends >/dev/null
  sudo locale-gen en_US.UTF-8 >/dev/null || true
  sudo update-locale LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 >/dev/null || true
fi
# Determine packages to install
PKGS=()
if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKGS+=(openjdk-17-jdk); fi
# Maven: if present ensure version >=3.8.6
MAVEN_OK=0
if command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MVN_VER=$(mvn -v 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/Apache Maven \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 || true)
  if [ -n "$MVN_VER" ]; then
    if dpkg --compare-versions "$MVN_VER" ge "3.8.6" 2>/dev/null; then MAVEN_OK=1; fi
  fi
fi
if [ "$MAVEN_OK" -ne 1 ]; then PKGS+=(maven); fi
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then PKGS+=(jq); fi
if [ ${#PKGS[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
  sudo apt-get update -q >/dev/null
  sudo apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends "${PKGS[@]}" >/dev/null
fi
# Validate java exists and major version >=17
if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "java not available" >&2; exit 11; fi
# Parse major version robustly for OpenJDK and other distributions
JAVA_FULL_VER=$(java -XshowSettings:properties -version 2>&1 | tr -d '\r' || true)
# Fallback parsing
JAVA_MAJOR=$(echo "$JAVA_FULL_VER" | sed -n 's/.*version "\([0-9][0-9]*\).*"/\1/p' | head -n1 || true)
if [ -z "$JAVA_MAJOR" ]; then
  # Try alternative: first number in version output
  JAVA_MAJOR=$(echo "$JAVA_FULL_VER" | sed -n 's/.*version "\([0-9][0-9]*\)\..*/\1/p' | head -n1 || true)
fi
if [ -z "$JAVA_MAJOR" ] || ! printf "%s" "$JAVA_MAJOR" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+$'; then
  echo "Unable to determine java major version from: $JAVA_FULL_VER" >&2
  exit 12
fi
if [ "${JAVA_MAJOR:-0}" -lt 17 ]; then
  echo "java major version <17 detected: $JAVA_MAJOR" >&2
  exit 12
fi
# Determine JAVA_HOME
JAVA_HOME=""
if command -v update-java-alternatives >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  JAVA_HOME=$(readlink -f "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v java)")")/.." ) || true
fi
if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -d /usr/lib/jvm ]; then
  JAVA_HOME=$(ls -d /usr/lib/jvm/java-*-openjdk* 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
fi
JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-}
# Persist environment to /etc/profile.d atomically
TMPFILE=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMPFILE" <<'PROFILE'
export LANG="en_US.UTF-8"
export LC_ALL="en_US.UTF-8"
export SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE="dev"
export SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL="jdbc:h2:mem:testdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1"
export SERVER_PORT="8080"
PROFILE
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then
  echo "export JAVA_HOME=\"$JAVA_HOME\"" >> "$TMPFILE"
  echo 'export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"' >> "$TMPFILE"
fi
sudo mv "$TMPFILE" /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh
# Source for immediate use (do not fail if not readable)
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
# Final validations
command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "mvn not available" >&2; exit 13; }
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "jq not available" >&2; exit 14; }
# Output versions
mvn -v | sed -n '1,2p' || true
java -version 2>&1 | sed -n '1,3p' || true
jq --version || true

steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-management-system-40496-40506/spring_backend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# source persisted env if available
[ -f /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh || true
: "${SERVER_PORT:=8080}"
: "${SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL:=jdbc:h2:mem:testdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1}"
: "${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE:=dev}"
# check port free
if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":${SERVER_PORT} "; then echo "port ${SERVER_PORT} in use" >&2; exit 2; fi
# locate jar (deterministic finalName)
JAR="$WORKSPACE/target/spring-backend-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar"
if [ ! -f "$JAR" ]; then JAR=$(ls -1 target/*.jar 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'original' | head -n1 || true); fi
[ -f "$JAR" ] || { echo "jar not found" >&2; exit 3; }
mkdir -p target
JAVA_OPTS="-Dspring.datasource.url=${SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL} -Dserver.port=${SERVER_PORT} -Dspring.profiles.active=${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE} -Xmx512m"
setsid sh -c "exec java $JAVA_OPTS -jar '$JAR'" > target/app.log 2>&1 &
APP_PID=$!
echo "$APP_PID" > target/app.pid
sleep 1
# record pgid
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$APP_PID" | tr -d ' ')
echo "$PGID" > target/app.pgid || true

steps.name: validation - build, start, check actuator health and stop gracefully with evidence
steps.description: Build the app, start it (via start step), check actuator /actuator/health returns HTTP 200 and JSON status UP within timeout, save health JSON to target/health.json, capture logs to target/app.log and include last lines as evidence, then stop the app gracefully (SIGTERM then SIGKILL after timeout). Operates in workspace: /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-management-system-40496-40506/spring_backend and depends on all prior setup steps.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/uttar-pradesh-tourism-infrastructure-management-system-40496-40506/spring_backend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# source persisted env
[ -f /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh || true
: "${SERVER_PORT:=8080}"
# ensure built
mvn -B -q -DskipTests package || { echo "mvn package failed" >&2; exit 2; }
# start via start step inline to keep idempotency
bash -c "$(sed -n '1,200p' <<<\"$(cat <<'S'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd \"$WORKSPACE\"
[ -f /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/spring_backend_env.sh || true
: \"${SERVER_PORT:=8080}\"
: \"${SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL:=jdbc:h2:mem:testdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1}\"
: \"${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE:=dev}\"
if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q \":${SERVER_PORT} \"; then echo \"port ${SERVER_PORT} in use\" >&2; exit 3; fi
JAR=\"$WORKSPACE/target/spring-backend-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar\"
if [ ! -f \"$JAR\" ]; then JAR=$(ls -1 target/*.jar 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'original' | head -n1 || true); fi
[ -f \"$JAR\" ] || { echo \"jar not found\" >&2; exit 4; }
mkdir -p target
JAVA_OPTS=\"-Dspring.datasource.url=${SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL} -Dserver.port=${SERVER_PORT} -Dspring.profiles.active=${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE} -Xmx512m\"
setsid sh -c \"exec java $JAVA_OPTS -jar '$JAR'\" > target/app.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > target/app.pid
S
)\" )"
# give app time and poll health
APP_PID_FILE=target/app.pid
[ -f "$APP_PID_FILE" ] || { echo "pid file missing" >&2; tail -n 200 target/app.log 2>/dev/null || true; exit 5; }
APP_PID=$(cat "$APP_PID_FILE")
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$APP_PID" | tr -d ' ' || true)
OK=0
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o target/health.json -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:${SERVER_PORT}/actuator/health" || echo "")
  if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
    if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      JSTAT=$(jq -r '.status' target/health.json 2>/dev/null || true)
      if [ "$JSTAT" = "UP" ]; then OK=1; break; fi
    else
      if grep -qi '"status".*"UP"' target/health.json; then OK=1; break; fi
    fi
  fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$OK" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "health check failed, saving evidence" >&2
  tail -n 300 target/app.log >&2 || true
  [ -f target/health.json ] && cat target/health.json >&2 || true
  # attempt cleanup
  if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then kill -TERM -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 2; kill -KILL -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  exit 6
fi
# capture last logs and health JSON as evidence
tail -n 200 target/app.log > target/app_last.log || true
# graceful stop
if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then
  kill -TERM -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true
  SECS=0
  while kill -0 -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; SECS=$((SECS+1)); if [ $SECS -ge 10 ]; then kill -KILL -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; break; fi; done
fi
sleep 1
echo "validation complete"
